description: This file defines classes related to JSON serialization and deserialization in a Flask application, including a base JSON provider and a default implementation using Python's json library.

classes.name: JSONProvider
classes.description: Base class for JSON operations, allowing customization of JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: DefaultJSONProvider
classes.description: Subclass of JSONProvider that uses Python's built-in json library for JSON operations, with additional data type support.

methods.name: dumps
methods.description: Serialize data as JSON to a string, with default parameters set.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serialize data as JSON and write to a file.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Deserialize data from a JSON string or bytes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserialize data from a file object.

methods.name: _prepare_response_obj
methods.description: Prepare the object to be serialized based on args and kwargs.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Serialize arguments as JSON and return a Flask Response object with JSON mimetype.

methods.name: _default
methods.description: Default function for serializing unsupported objects, handling dates, UUIDs, dataclasses, and HTML objects.
